featured_reviews.name: Pooja Bansode
featured_reviews.review_text: I had an amazing learning experience at Nikita Arora Makeup Academy. The teaching style is very practical and easy to understand. Every technique is explained in detail, and I gained so much confidence during the course. Nikita Ma’am is an incredible mentor who genuinely cares about every student’s growth and success. Highly recommended for anyone who wants to build a career in makeup!

featured_reviews.name: pooja chawla
featured_reviews.review_text:
I cannot thank Nikita Arora enough for the incredible job she did for my wedding and reception!
She understood exactly what I wanted and created two stunning looks for me — my wedding makeup was elegant and timeless, and my reception look was glamorous yet still felt completely like me. She enhanced my features so beautifully without making the makeup look heavy or overdone.
The makeup stayed absolutely flawless through all the rituals, endless photos and dancing.
She made me feel confident, comfortable, and like the most beautiful version of myself.
I received so many compliments, and I couldn’t have chosen a better artist for such an important occasion. Highly recommend Nikita to every bride-to-be! 💕

featured_reviews.name: Chhaya Rathod
featured_reviews.review_text: I came to Nikita Arora Makeup Academy with very little knowledge about makeup, but after completing my course, I feel confident working on clients. The classes are well-organized, and the techniques taught are trendy and professional. Nikita Ma’am’s personal guidance and attention to detail helped me achieve results beyond my expectations. The portfolio and certification process was also beautifully managed.

featured_reviews.name: Ranjeeta Varma
featured_reviews.review_text: I got my bridal makeup done by Nikittaa Arora, and I honestly couldn’t have asked for a better experience! From my Haldi and Mehndi looks to Sangeet, Wedding, and Reception, every look was unique, flawless, and perfectly matched the vibe of each function. She understood my preferences so well and made me feel like the best version of myself. Her makeup products were top-quality and completely hygienic, and she maintained utmost cleanliness throughout. What I loved most was her calm and friendly nature — she made the entire experience stress-free even amidst the wedding chaos. The makeup stayed intact for hours, looked stunning in photos, and received endless compliments. Nikita truly knows how to enhance natural beauty without overdoing it. Highly recommend her to every bride-to-be — she’s an absolute gem to have on your big day!

featured_reviews.name: Jinal Botadra
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had an absolutely wonderful experience with Nikita Arora and her team for my 2-day event makeup, and I truly couldn’t have asked for better.

From the very first interaction, Nikita was extremely professional, warm and patient. She took the time to understand my preferences and created looks that were perfectly suited to my face, outfit and the occasion.

The team was right on time on both days, which made everything completely stress-free. Their hygiene standards were top-notch — all brushes, products and tools were properly cleaned and sanitized, which really matters to me.

The quality of the makeup was outstanding. My makeup looked fresh, elegant and flawless for many hours without any touch-ups, even after long functions and lots of movement. I received so many compliments from family and friends on both days — everyone kept asking who did my makeup!

What I appreciated most was the team’s calm behaviour, positive energy and attention to detail. They made me feel relaxed, confident and truly special on such important days.

I highly recommend Nikita Arora Bridal Makeup Studio & Academy to every bride and anyone looking for professional, high-quality makeup with a wonderful experience overall. Thank you Nikita for making my days even more memorable! 💕✨

featured_reviews.name: Prachi Patel
featured_reviews.review_text: An absolutely exceptional experience. I went in without a defined look and placed my full trust in her, and she delivered beyond anything I could have imagined. The makeup was flawless, elegant, and perfectly tailored to me. Her professionalism truly stands out, and her entire team was equally polished, attentive, and seamless in execution. Everything felt elevated and thoughtfully done. Thanks a lot✨

featured_reviews.name: Charmi Parmar
featured_reviews.review_text: Absolutely loved the engagement look! The makeup was elegant, flawless, and photographed beautifully. She enhanced my features while keeping it soft and natural — exactly what I wanted. Highly recommend for brides-to-be!
